description: A complex heterogeneous malignancy originating in breast tissue, characterized by abnormal cell proliferation.

associations.disease_role: Tumor suppressor gene; germline mutations drastically increase hereditary breast and ovarian cancer risk.
Nuclear hormone receptor driving ER-positive breast cancer cell proliferation.
Proto-oncogene receptor amplified in HER2-positive aggressive breast tumors.
Master guardian of the genome; mutated in >50% of triple-negative breast cancers.
Catalytic subunit of PI3K hyperactivated in hormone-receptor positive tumors.
DNA homologous recombination repair protein mutated in familial breast cancer.
